paper.title_en: Impact of Magnetic Field Topology on Electromagnetic and Gravitational Waves from Binary Neutron Star Merger Remnants
paper.abstract_en: We perform general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers with four distinct magnetic field topologies: (i) a dipole pulsar-like configuration, (ii) a mixed linear superposition of poloidal and toroidal components inside the star, and (iii-iv) two topologies featuring a smooth transition from a confined mixed core to a pulsar-like structure at radii $0.95\,R_{\rm NS}$ and $0.5\,R_{\rm NS}$, with $R_{\rm NS}$ the radius of the star. The latter topologies are explored in BNS merger studies for the first time. We evolve systems with two equations of state (EoS), SLy and WFF1, with ADM masses 2.7 and 2.6, respectively, and include an additional lower-mass SLy binary to probe the behavior of long-lived remnants. We perform an extensive analysis of the emission properties of the systems, both electromagnetic and gravitational waves, and of the properties of the remnants, namely their frequency modes, density eigenfunctions, rotation, temperature, and convective stability. We report three key results: (1) for the first time, we assess the convective stability of magnetized remnants, extending previous unmagnetized analyses; (2) we identify a clear secondary peak in the gravitational-wave spectrum of pulsar-like configurations, consistent with the nonlinear coupling of the $m=0$ and $m=2$ modes, which is absent in other topologies; and (3) the magnetic field topology strongly influences the gravitational wave emission properties to the extent that nearby ($<50\,{\rm Mpc}$) events could allow one to observationally distinguish between different field structures with future gravitational-wave detectors. Across all models, we obtain luminosities compatible with short gamma-ray bursts (sGRBs), with purely poloidal configurations being the most efficient in driving possible relativistic jets.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 论文主题为双中子星并合的广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟及其电磁与引力波辐射，属于相对论天体物理与引力波源研究，而非本索引所关注的四个方向（黑洞热力学、脉冲星计时阵列、全息凝聚态、广义相对论基础）。虽然提及ADM质量，但并非对广义相对论基础或引力理论的检验，因此相关性不足。
decision.title_zh: 磁场拓扑对双中子星并合遗迹电磁与引力波辐射的影响
decision.abstract_zh: 我们对双中子星（BNS）并合进行了广义相对论磁流体动力学（GRMHD）模拟，采用了四种不同的磁场拓扑：(i) 类似脉冲星的偶极位形；(ii) 恒星内部极向与环向分量的混合线性叠加；以及 (iii-iv) 两种具有从受限混合核心到半径 $0.95\,R_{\rm NS}$ 和 $0.5\,R_{\rm NS}$ 处类似脉冲星结构的平滑过渡的拓扑，其中 $R_{\rm NS}$ 为恒星半径。后两种拓扑是首次在双中子星并合研究中被探索。我们分别采用 SLy 和 WFF1 两种状态方程（EoS）演化系统，其 ADM 质量分别为 2.7 和 2.6，并额外加入一个质量更低的 SLy 双星系统以探究长寿命遗迹的行为。我们对系统的辐射性质（电磁波和引力波）以及遗迹的性质（即其频率模式、密度本征函数、旋转、温度和 convective 稳定性）进行了广泛分析。我们报告三个关键结果：(1) 我们首次评估了磁化遗迹的对流稳定性，扩展了先前对非磁化遗迹的分析；(2) 我们在类脉冲星位形的引力波谱中识别出一个明显的次级峰，与 $m=0$ 和 $m=2$ 模式的非线性耦合一致，而其他拓扑中不存在该峰；(3) 磁场拓扑强烈影响引力波辐射性质，其程度达到附近（$<50\,{\rm Mpc}$）事件或可借助未来引力波探测器观测区分不同的场结构。在所有模型中，我们获得的光度与短伽马射线暴（sGRBs）相容，其中纯极向位形在驱动可能的相对论性喷流方面最为高效。
